description: Source code defining classes and functions related to reporting endpoints and endpoint groups in the Chromium project, including key classes like ReportingEndpointGroupKey, ReportingEndpoint, and CachedReportingEndpointGroup.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey
classes.description: Represents a unique key for a reporting endpoint group, including network anonymization, origin, reporting source, and group name.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint
classes.description: Represents a reporting endpoint with associated group key and endpoint info such as URL, priority, and weight.

classes.name: ReportingEndpoint::EndpointInfo
classes.description: Holds information about an individual reporting endpoint, including URL, priority, and weight.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of reporting endpoints.

classes.name: CachedReportingEndpointGroup
classes.description: A cached version of a reporting endpoint group with expiration and usage metadata.

methods.name: ReportingEndpointGroupKey::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the reporting endpoint group key.

methods.name: ReportingEndpoint::is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the reporting endpoint's URL is valid.
